changelog:
ai-content-repurposer v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Automatically converts long-form content (articles, blogs, transcripts, videos) into platform-optimized formats: Twitter threads, LinkedIn posts, newsletter editions, and short video scripts.
- Highly customizable: configure brand voice, tone, CTA, hashtag strategy, platform-specific limits, and output formatting via YAML.
- Built-in quality checks for character limits, tone, quote accuracy, link integrity, CTA presence, and more.
- Supports multiple input formats, including markdown, text, HTML, PDF, YouTube, RSS feeds, and WordPress URLs.
- Batch and scheduled processing, as well as command interface for queue/status management.
- Modular template system for easy adaptation to different content styles and publishing strategies.
summary: Takes one long-form piece of content and repurposes it into Twitter threads, LinkedIn posts, newsletter editions, and short video scripts.
